From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
This is a list of the world's largest non-[governmental](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government-owned_corporation "Government-owned corporation") [privately held companies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Privately-held_company "Privately-held company") by [revenue](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revenue "Revenue"). This list does not include [state-owned enterprises](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government-owned_corporation "Government-owned corporation") like [Sinopec](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sinopec "Sinopec"), [State Grid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_Grid "State Grid"), [China National Petroleum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China_National_Petroleum "China National Petroleum"), [Kuwait Petroleum Corporation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kuwait_Petroleum_Corporation "Kuwait Petroleum Corporation"), [Pemex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pemex "Pemex"), [Petrobras](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Petrobras "Petrobras"), [PDVSA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PDVSA "PDVSA") and others. These corporations have revenues of at least [US$](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/US$ "US$")10 billion.
